$comment: Paperclip control-plane adapter CONTRACT (Phase 3). Exclusively network adapters — hermes_local is FORBIDDEN inside the container (spec ADR-01). URLs target host.docker.internal; on Linux docker-compose maps it via extra_hosts. NOTE (ADR-06 schema caution): the real Paperclip (ghcr.io/paperclipai/paperclip) does not read this file directly — agents are configured per-agent via the Paperclip UI/API as {adapterType, adapterConfig} with secrets stored as Paperclip secret references. This file documents the Sisyphus-side durable contract: URLs, auth headers, and the ADR-05 persistSession:false mapping.

realSchemaMapping.$comment: Verified against docs.paperclip.ing/reference/adapters/ (master, 2026-11). Paperclip has NO persistSession field; the real equivalent of ADR-05/#1160 persistSession:false is sessionKeyStrategy:'run' (a new session per run — fully isolated runs, no shared memory). sessionKeyStrategy:'issue' (Paperclip default) WOULD persist sessions per issue and is therefore forbidden until the upstream session-ID regex fix (Paperclip #1160) is validated.
realSchemaMapping.gooseAdapters: Paperclip has no native goose adapter; goose serve speaks ACP (validated against installed goose 1.56.0). Wire via Paperclip's ACP engine / custom adapter once agent wiring lands (Phase 4+). The X-Secret-Key header and URLs below are the validated durable contract.

adapterConfig.$comment: dangerouslyAllowInsecureRemoteHttp is required because host.docker.internal is non-loopback HTTP; production must switch to HTTPS or a private overlay and set this back to false.

adapters.$comment_persistSession: ADR-05 / Paperclip #1160: false until the session-ID regex fix is validated upstream. Real-schema equivalent: sessionKeyStrategy:'run'.

adapters.$comment: Auth header validated against installed goose 1.56.0 (Bearer is rejected with 401). ACP initialize handshake from inside the container validated (Phase 3 Go/No-Go). Spawn on demand via the Host Launcher (ADR-07): POST http://host.docker.internal:9000/launch?profile=dev&engine=goose
Same launcher trigger: POST /launch?profile=reviewer&engine=goose. ACP handshake validated from inside the container.

launcher.$comment: ADR-07 — daemon lifecycle management. The launcher binds 127.0.0.1 by default; container-originated triggers to :9000 are refused BY DESIGN (verified Phase 3): Paperclip talks to the adapters directly, not to the launcher. If that topology changes, start it with LAUNCHER_HOST=0.0.0.0 (secret then mandatory).
